info.name: Global System for Mobile Communications GSMA Camara Project Endpoint Discovery Application Call Forwarding Information Retrieval API
Global System for Mobile Communications Retrieve the information about the type of call forwarding service active on a phone number (PhoneNumber)

items.docs: This endpoint provides information about wich type of call forwarding service is active. More than one service can be active, e.g. conditional and unconditional. This endpoint exceeds the main scope of the CFS API, for this reason an error code 501 can be returned.
